_doc: Per-player looks, keyed by full name exactly as in players.json. Merged into players.json by tools/build_rosters.py (also in CI). Fields: skin (hex), hair (folder in hair/ or 'none'), hair_color (hex), face {blend shape: 0..1} — names in assets/players/player_meta.json. Players not listed get a neutral look with a stable variation.
